name: Myopathic Intestinal Pseudoobstruction
aliases: Chronic Intestinal Pseudoobstruction due to Myopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Myopathic Intestinal Pseudoobstruction

criteria.description: Chronic symptoms of intestinal dysmotility mimicking mechanical obstruction without evidence of mechanical cause
Histopathological evidence of smooth muscle abnormalities in intestinal biopsy or full-thickness specimen
Radiologic imaging showing dilated bowel loops with air-fluid levels and no mechanical obstruction
Exclusion of neuropathic, metabolic, infectious, and mechanical causes of pseudoobstruction
Abnormal intestinal manometry consistent with myopathic pattern

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of chronic gastrointestinal dysmotility symptoms, histopathologic evidence of myopathy, radiologic evidence of pseudoobstruction, and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires multidisciplinary evaluation including gastroenterology, pathology, and radiology.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Chronic intestinal dysmotility with recurrent pseudoobstruction episodes
Histopathologic smooth muscle degeneration in intestinal biopsies

common.symptomName: Abdominal distension due to bowel dilation
searchTerms: abdominal swelling due to bowel enlargement

common.symptomName: Nausea and vomiting associated with impaired intestinal transit
searchTerms: nausea and vomiting from slow bowel
vomiting related to poor intestinal transit

common.symptomName: Chronic constipation or severe bowel movement irregularity
Weight loss secondary to malabsorption and poor intake
searchTerms: weight loss from poor nutrient absorption
losing weight due to poor intake

common.symptomName: Abdominal pain related to bowel dysmotility

searchTerms: too many bacteria in small bowel
mineral imbalances due to poor absorption
low blood minerals caused by digestion issues
persistent exhaustion due to health problems
dilated large intestine at risk of tearing

rare.symptomName: Associated skeletal myopathy or muscle weakness
searchTerms: muscle weakness linked to bone issues

rare.symptomName: Autonomic dysfunction symptoms such as orthostatic hypotension
searchTerms: autonomic symptoms like low blood pressure when standing

imaging: Abdominal X-ray or CT showing dilated bowel loops without mechanical obstruction
other: Full-thickness intestinal biopsy showing smooth muscle degeneration and fibrosis
Abnormal intestinal manometry consistent with myopathic pattern

distinguishingFeatures: Histopathology shows neuronal abnormalities rather than smooth muscle degeneration

redFlags: Signs of bowel perforation or peritonitis
Severe electrolyte imbalances refractory to treatment
Rapid clinical deterioration with sepsis or shock
references: Sarna SK, et al. Chronic Intestinal Pseudoobstruction: Pathophysiology and Clinical Management. Gastroenterology Clinics. 2020.
